cylinders: The nurse was on one side and the doctor stood on the other side of the table beside some cylinders.
cylinder: Mr O’Connor, a grey-haired young man, whose face was disfigured by many blotches and pimples, had just brought the tobacco for a cigarette into a shapely cylinder but when spoken to he undid his handiwork meditatively.
He came out of the pawn-office joyfully, making a little cylinder, of the coins between his thumb and fingers.
